gaps.title: Missing Distinct Schemas and Models for Protocols and Data
gaps.jtbd: When cataloging the knowledge base, I want to manage protocols and raw data with their specific structural attributes, so that researchers can search and view them as distinct entity types rather than generic text materials.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given a user wants to add a protocol, when they submit the details, then the system validates and stores protocol-specific attributes (such as procedural steps and author approvals); given a user wants to upload epidemiological data, when they submit the data, then the system validates and stores data-specific structures (such as sample metrics and collection parameters).
gaps.reason: The brief explicitly requests cataloging, searching, and managing three distinct kinds of entities: epidemiological 'materials' (материалы), 'protocols' (протоколы), and 'data' (данные). However, the database schema (V20260812160934550__full_text_search.sql) and the Java service/DTO layers only define and implement a single generic 'materials' entity with a flat title and content, completely omitting distinct representations or endpoints for protocols and raw epidemiological data.

gaps.title: Missing Versioning and Revision History for Protocols and Materials
gaps.jtbd: When an epidemiological protocol or material description is updated, I want the system to track previous versions and maintain a revision history, so that I can audit changes and revert to older versions to ensure clinical compliance and procedural safety.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given an existing protocol is edited and saved, when I view its detailed page, then I can see a list of historical revisions showing who changed what and when, with the ability to view the content of any past version.
gaps.reason: In any professional scientific/clinical knowledge base (база знаний) representing protocols and standards, version control and change tracking are critical domain-standard requirements to prevent unauthorized or undocumented changes to high-risk laboratory procedures. The frontend mockups include a 'History' navigation item, but neither the backend database schema nor the API endpoints support tracking, storing, or retrieving historical revisions of the materials/protocols.
